metrics.title: Measurements
metrics.about: Kit operations measurements, not manager reports. See how long a run went without a connection and where the tokens went.
metrics.refresh_hint: Re-read network snapshots and token records. New ones appear after the next run.
metrics.net_about: Network and system VPN snapshots around runs. “Blocked” is how long the network did not answer. VPN names are recorded on purpose: they show which provider lost its connection.
metrics.net_empty: No network snapshots yet. They appear after a run that needs a connection.
metrics.tokens_about: Usage by project, agent role and model. Older runs without a breakdown are shown as totals only.
metrics.tokens_empty: Token accounting starts with this release: numbers appear after the first run.
metrics.old: No breakdown by role and model: {n} older runs, counted as totals only.
